scope: One independent arithmetic replay of existing archived proof witnesses. No original module imports/execution, rootfinding, new geometry sample, factorization, package, shared-file mutation, or experimental rerun.
freeze: H019-review-freeze.json hashes the review source, this protocol, every original archive file, and the other reviewed immutable sources before execution. Current STATE hash is provenance only, as the coordinator can change it. No certificate predicate execution precedes freeze; static syntax parsing is permitted.

execution.remaining_budget_rule: Each cap is min(registered group cap, 53 minus elapsed). Entire fresh worker process group is killed on timeout. Monotonic clock starts before creating output directory. Hash checking, public input reproduction, prime checking, worker startup, arithmetic, evidence I/O and sealing are charged.
execution.failure_policy: Keep all nine case statuses. Never rerun or repair the frozen verifier after its one execution. Archive errors honestly; partial stage counters are lower observations, missing work is unknown. No status is verified if any checked gate fails.
execution.interpretation: Audit verified means the archived outcome and applicable exact predicates match. It does not turn an original unknown into a count certificate. Original 1 pass and 3 unknown outcomes remain separate. All nine verified is required for complete review coverage. This is not H019's continuation criterion.

preflight: Check all frozen review input/source hashes, original seal, 13 frozen sources, six frozen input files and completion link.
Independently trial divide P=65537 by every integer 2 through 256; compare all archived remainders.

Reproduce the same four archived inputs using one random.Random(1919), exactly one getrandbits(n-1) per listed case, N=(1<<(n-1))|draw|1. Compare hex, metadata, N-only object and its hash. This reconstructs existing public inputs, not a new sample.
Reconstruct the five expanded control definitions with Q=2^40, radius=2^-24 and nearest sqrt(2)*Q via isqrt and exact squared midpoint comparison.
Check logged original order, caps, ordinary zero worker exits and within-cap wall times. Historical absence of unlogged runs is not independently attestable by hashes.
per_research_case: Verify N domain and public d. Check archived m by exact powers m^d<=N<(m+1)^d. Reconstruct ordinary digits by divmod, compare every f coefficient, actual degree, monicity, digit bounds and Horner f(m)=N.
Check polynomial Bezout witness modulo verified 65537 by independently accumulating each output coefficient; no extended-gcd implementation imported.
Recompute strict coefficient-(d-2) dominance at R=2H+2, both big-product hashes and widths; this counts exactly d-2 interior and two exterior roots.

Check stored approximate metadata (1..500 sweeps, finite stored correction <=2^-42) and independently rationalize recorded finite binary64 centers by exact Fraction rounding to denominator Q=2^40. Do not evaluate or rerun Aberth or claim the recorded trajectory was independently reproduced.
Verify exactly d-2 integer-coordinate disks, strict squared pair disjointness and strict squared containment in R, with TQ=Q/2^24=2^16.

Rebuild Q^d times the full-f Taylor array by accumulating monomial contributions f_i*C(i,j)*(x+iy)^(i-j)*Q^(d-i+j), using precomputed Gaussian powers and a binomial recurrence. The direct binomial identity is shared mathematically with the original reference, but no original helpers are called. Compare each archived full-array SHA-256 and cleared predicate lhs/rhs hex, hashes, widths and strict decisions.

The cleared Taylor inequality is max(|Re A1|,|Im A1|)*S^(d-1) > sum_(j!=1)(|Re Aj|+|Im Aj|)*S^(d-j), S=2^24. Full-f one-root disks plus the global count account for all roots, including complex conjugates and the unlocated two.

Reconstruct U_i=max(1,|Re z_i|+|Im z_i|+1/S) and L_ij=max(0,max-coordinate-difference-2/S) with Fraction. Verify all archived reduced pair bounds. Compute kappa as minimum over every pair-product triple divided by six; compare reduced numerator/denominator, positivity and first lexicographic minimizing triple.

Check every factored operand/exponent in equation 11 with E=5*d*(d-4). Independently multiply powers with math.prod; use an actual H power, not the original bit-shift implementation. Check hashes, widths and lhs>=rhs decision. Evaluate C=(hstar-1)*(2*hstar-1)^2+d-2 exactly. C is an upper-bound certificate only if all prerequisites AND this comparison pass.
Check archived candidate/reference status agreement and selected operation counters against recorded sweeps and exact loop cardinalities. No quadratic population is enumerated.
controls: Recheck all four unit Bezout witnesses. Apply the same independent disk and geometry predicates to controls until their designated rejection gate. For (X-1)^2, directly verify f(1)=f'(1)=0 and nonzero linear derivative, hence modular gcd degree one. Do not claim Taylor verification for controls rejected before that gate.
acceptance_scope: Accept only proof-linked finite certificates whose archived gates are all independently checked. Require both largest original cases for H019 continuation; preserve INCONCLUSIVE if n65536-d34 remains unknown. No finite all-output bound from big-O, no field irreducibility, relation density, asymptotic or factoring improvement. Verified full factoring complexity improvement NONE.
